rows.question: Find all different topics of projects that ended in 2014
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  tc.code AS code,
  tc.title AS title
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.ec_ref,
    p.framework_program
  FROM projects p
) AS projects_core_21
JOIN (
  SELECT
    pt.project AS project,
    pt.topic AS topic
  FROM project_topics pt
) AS project_topics_link
  ON projects_core_21.unics_id = project_topics_link.project
JOIN (
  SELECT
    t.code AS code,
    t.title AS title,
    t.rcn AS rcn
  FROM topics t
) AS tc
  ON project_topics_link.topic = tc.code
WHERE projects_core_21.end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM projects_core_21.end_date) = 2014
ORDER BY tc.code ASC

rows.question: Show names of institutions from France or Germany
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_members_minimal AS (
  SELECT
    pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
    pm.country AS country
  FROM project_members pm
),
countries_core AS (
  SELECT
    c.unics_id AS unics_id,
    c.country_name AS country_name,
    c.country_code2 AS country_code2,
    c.country_code3 AS country_code3,
    c.geocode_country_code AS geocode_country_code
  FROM countries c
),
institutions_core AS (
  SELECT
    i.unics_id,
    i.institutions_name,
    i.acronym,
    i.country_id,
    i.geocode_regions_3,
    i.website,
    i.grid_id
  FROM institutions i
)
SELECT DISTINCT ic.institutions_name
FROM institutions_core ic
WHERE
  ic.country_id IN (
    SELECT cc.unics_id
    FROM countries_core cc
    WHERE cc.country_name IN ('France', 'Germany')
       OR cc.country_code2 IN ('FR', 'DE')
       OR cc.country_code3 IN ('FRA', 'DEU')
       OR cc.geocode_country_code IN ('FR', 'DE')
  )
  OR ic.unics_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT pm.institution_id
    FROM project_members_minimal pm
    WHERE pm.country IN ('France', 'Germany')
  )
ORDER BY ic.institutions_name

rows.question: Show names of institutions which are not from France

SELECT institutions_with_country.institutions_name
FROM (
  SELECT
    institutions.unics_id AS institutions_unics_id,
    institutions.institutions_name AS institutions_name,
    institutions.country_id AS institutions_country_id,
    countries.unics_id AS countries_unics_id,
    countries.country_name AS countries_country_name,

    countries.country_code3 AS countries_country_code3,
    countries.geocode_country_code AS countries_geocode_country_code

FROM (

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    start_year,
    end_year
  FROM projects
),
project_financials_by_project AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    MIN(p.start_date) AS min_start_date,
    MAX(p.end_date) AS max_end_date
  FROM projects_core p
  GROUP BY p.unics_id
),
projects_core_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    COALESCE(p.title, '') AS title,
    COALESCE(p.start_year,
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer,
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.min_start_date)::integer) AS start_year,
    COALESCE(p.end_year,
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer,
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.max_end_date)::integer) AS end_year,
    (
      COALESCE(p.end_year,
               EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer,
               EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.max_end_date)::integer)
      -
      COALESCE(p.start_year,
               EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer,
               EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pf.min_start_date)::integer)
    )::integer AS duration_years
  FROM projects_core p
  LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project pf ON p.unics_id = pf.unics_id
)
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.duration_years
FROM projects_core_years p
WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
  AND p.duration_years = (
    SELECT MAX(duration_years)
    FROM projects_core_years
    WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
      AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY p.duration_years DESC, p.unics_id
